newsitem.title: USA: Federated Feb same-store sales up 2.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Federated Feb same-store sales up 2.2 pct.

text.p: Federated Department Stores Inc on Thursday reported sales of $1.06 billion for the four weeks ended March 1, 1997, up 2.5 percent from the year-ago's $1.03 billion, while same-store sales rose 2.2 percent.

Allen Questrom, Federated's chairman and chief executive officer, said the company was pleased with its February performance, which was consistent with expectations. He noted that the company's 2.2 percent same-store sales increase came on top of a 9.0 percent same-store sales increase in February last year, which proved to be the strongest month of the 1996 spring season.

Federated currently operates more than 400 department stores and 150 specialty stores in 36 states. Federated's department stores operate nationally under the names Bloomingdale's, The Bon Marche, Burdines, Goldsmith's, Lazarus, Macy's, Rich's and Stern's.
